name: Vrinda Haldia
headline: Bridging Royal Heritage with Procreate Tactility.

voiceNote.title: A Note on Tactile Authenticity
voiceNote.speaker: Vrinda Haldia
voiceNote.transcript: When I left traditional gouache and gold leaf for the iPad Pro, I missed the friction of cotton paper and the raw weight of pigment. That is why we calibrated every single brush in our library to resist the smooth glass screen and honor real Indian handloom craft.

fragments.title: Decade of Haute Couture
fragments.text: Trained in classical fashion design and Indian textiles, sketching runway collections with pure gouache and gold leaves.

fragments.title: 35+ Proprietary Brushes
fragments.text: Hand-calibrating pressure curves and dual-texture engines to capture zardozi metallic thread sheen and organza grain.

fragments.title: 2,500+ Mentored Artists
fragments.text: Empowering beginner illustrators and bridal ateliers across 18 countries to master confident iPad Pro craftsmanship.
